# er605_acl_rule (Resource)

Firewall > Access control rule. position is not exposed (the router does not return it): new rules go last. src/dest are ip_group names (or Any/Me); zone e.g. ["LAN"] = LAN->WAN.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dest` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `policy` (String) DROP or ACCEPT
- `service` (String) service name, ALL for any
- `src` (String)
- `time` (String) time object, Any for always
- `zone` (List of String)

### Optional

- `states` (List of String) subset of new, established, invalid, related

### Read-Only

- `dest_if` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `src_if` (String)
